subject: Eval success signal dossier — acceptance scenarios & timeline
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.inference>
To: Laila Ahmed <laila@veridianhealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-06-01T09:04:00Z
Subject: Eval success signal dossier — acceptance scenarios & timeline

Hi Laila / team,

Attaching our draft MAP and a compact acceptance-tests doc to align on what 'success' looks like for the 2-week evaluation. Key bits below — please review and confirm owners by EOD Friday so we can lock dates. I attached: MAP-draft-v3.xlsx (mutual action plan), acceptance-tests.md (detailed runbook) and a quick latency screenshot for the baseline.

Top-level success signals (synthesized):
- Functional: sample-ops concordance >= 92% on your 150 test prompts (see testset tab).
- Latency: p95 inference latency <= 350ms under pilot traffic profile.
- Stability: zero-unplanned restarts, error rate <= 0.5% over a 72-hour canary.
- Cost guardrail: steady-state token cost <= $2.50 per 1,000 tokens (projected).
- Security/compliance: data retention and audit logs validated for the pilot; KMS integration verified.

Exit gates / decision checkpoints (timeboxed):
- Canary (72 hours): run small traffic (2k req/day) — pass all smoke tests and stability checks.
- Pilot (2 weeks): confirm signal thresholds for concordance and p95 latency; if either fails to meet thresholds after remediation window, we trigger rollback.
- Final go/no-go: product + your engineering signoff and procurement checkpoints complete.

Acceptance-test highlights (see acceptance-tests.md):
1) Smoke: end-to-end request/response, model variant fallback, KV-cache correctness.
2) Regression: 150 prompt check, concordance scoring, sample diff report.
3) Load: incremental ramp to pilot profile, observe p50/p95/p99.
4) Security: example audit events, KMS-encrypted payloads, retention proof.

Open asks for Veridian before we schedule the canary:
- Confirm the test dataset owner and final prompt set (file or Drive link).
- Confirm whether procurement needs the SOC2 artifacts before pilot start.
- Proposed canary window: Mon 6/7 09:00 — Thu 6/10 09:00 UTC. Is that OK?

If we agree, next steps: lock owners in the MAP sheet, DocuSign signature for the pilot addendum, and we’ll provision the dedicated test pool.

Thanks — Kim
Kimberly Park
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.inference

Attachments: MAP-draft-v3.xlsx (spreadsheet), acceptance-tests.md (markdown), latency-slo-screenshot.png (png)
From: Laila Ahmed <laila@veridianhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.inference>
Cc: Veridian Health Procurement <procurement@veridianhealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-06-01T13:18:00Z
Subject: Re: Eval success signal dossier — acceptance scenarios & timeline

Thanks Kim — useful and thorough. A few quick clarifications before we commit to the proposed canary window: 

On Tue, 2027-06-01 at 09:04, Kimberly Park wrote:
> Attaching our draft MAP and a compact acceptance-tests doc to align on what 'success' looks like for the 2-week evaluation...

Questions / notes:
- Data retention: for the pilot we need retention proof for 30 days (internal requirement); can you confirm the audit log format and a sample export?
- Concordance target: 92% feels aggressive on a general prompt set — can we get a breakdown vs. our clinical prompts vs. consumer-facing prompts?
- Procurement: we need a copy of SOC2 / data processing addendum before procurement signs; procurement included in cc.
- Schedule: the 6/7 canary is fine, but our engineering lead is on leave 6/8—would you be able to start canary 6/9 instead so their on-call can triage if needed?

We can sign off quickly once we have: the retention proof sample, a short concordance breakdown, and SOC2 copy.

— Laila
Laila Ahmed
Director, AI Integrations, Veridian Health
laila@veridianhealth.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>
To: Laila Ahmed <laila@veridianhealth.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.inference>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-06-02T10:33:00Z
Subject: Re: Eval success signal dossier — acceptance scenarios & timeline

Hi Laila — quick answers and pre-commit items from our side.

Audit / retention: we’ll produce a 30-day retention sample export in CSV and show the audit event stream (timestamps + event type + request id). I’ll attach a sample CSV to the MAP and drop the schema to the Hub doc. Expect files by tomorrow EOD (6/3).

Concordance: agreed that a single % can hide nuance. Proposed breakdown (we will run against your labeled set):
- Clinical prompts (n=60): target concordance >= 90%
- Consumer-facing prompts (n=60): target >= 94%
- Edge/ambiguous prompts (n=30): target >= 85% (with documented remediation notes)
We’ll publish a per-prompt diff report so you can see exact failure modes.

Canary scheduling: moving start to 6/9 is fine. Proposed updated windows:
- Canary: Wed 6/9 09:00 UTC — Sat 6/12 09:00 UTC (72h)
- Pilot: Mon 6/14 — Fri 6/25 (2 weeks)

Operational runbook highlights (also in acceptance-tests.md):
- Measurement cadence: dashboards refresh every 30 min, concordance report daily.
- Canary pass = no critical regressions + p95 latency <= 350ms + error rate <= 0.5%. If any threshold fails, we get a 24-hour remediation window. Continued failure triggers rollback.
- Canary traffic profile: 2k requests/day with the same distribution as your projected pilot mix.

I’ll upload the retention sample and the runbook excerpt to the shared doc. Let me know if procurement needs the SOC2 PDF in a specific format for their records.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>

Date: 2027-06-04T16:22:00Z

All — summary and next steps to lock the MAP and start provisioning.

Summary (agreed):
- Canary: Wed 2027-06-09 09:00 UTC — Sat 2027-06-12 09:00 UTC (72h).
- Pilot: Mon 2027-06-14 — Fri 2027-06-25 (2 weeks).
- Signal thresholds: concordance broken down by prompt class (clinical/consumer/edge) as Ben described; p95 latency <= 350ms; error rate <= 0.5%.
- Artifacts: Redwood to provide retention sample (CSV), audit-event export schema, SOC2 PDF.

Owners & immediate actions (please treat these as commitments):
- Redwood (Ben): upload retention sample + runbook excerpt to the shared doc by 2027-06-03 EOD.
- Veridian (Laila): confirm final prompt set and provide Drive link by 2027-06-04 EOD.
- Redwood (Kim): update MAP-draft-v3.xlsx with owner column and push DocuSign link for pilot addendum by 2027-06-05 EOD.
- Procurement (Veridian): confirm whether SOC2 needs to be uploaded to a procurement portal or emailed to procurement@veridianhealth.com by 2027-06-06.

If everyone signs off on these owner commitments I will:
1) Push the MAP into HubSpot and attach the DocuSign transaction (DEAL-8892).
2) Provision the dedicated test pool and reserve the canary window.

Please reply-all with an explicit ack or any blocking constraints. If I don’t hear objections by 6/5 17:00 UTC we’ll treat this as the operational plan and proceed.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
